column1: It's not just oil and natural gas production that's booming; we're becoming a global leader in renewable energy. And we're doing so not just because we care about our planet, although we do. But because jobs are created, and businesses are growing, all while making America more energy independent. That is why we're committed to an all-of-the-above energy strategy here in America.

Now, little more than 40 years ago, astronauts descended the nine-rung ladder of the lunar module, stepping onto the surface of the moon. With those first steps, they took a giant leap for all mankind. As we set our sights on the future, we must ask: What great feats of human endeavor will be achieved in the coming decades? I believe we're called upon to boldly venture forth in the face of uncertainty. We must discover new frontiers for science and technology.

We agree that real opportunity requires every American to get the education and training they need to compete in a 21st century economy. So we've invested in education, from Head Start to college. We've invested in research and development. And we’ve made the most significant investments in clean energy in history. We’ve done it all, because we know that a strong American economy is built from the middle class outwards.

For we, the people, understand that our country cannot succeed when a shrinking few do well, while so many others struggle. We know that America thrives when the middle class thrives. We know that our economy thrives when everyone gets a fair shot, when everyone does their fair share, and when everyone plays by the same rules. We believe in an America that works for all of us. That’s what we believe. And that's what we'll keep fighting for.

One senator, as you all are aware, had put a hold on every single nominee for an extended period. The time has come for us to take action, right away. To put an end to this reckless behavior as quickly as possible. I cannot understand why anyone would want to block a vote. Blocking a vote on the nominees is simply wrong and does not reflect the best interests of the American people. It harms us all when we play petty politics.
